evals.prompt: Build me a user authentication and profile management system with social login.
evals.expected_output: The skill generates a requirements.md with functional/non-functional criteria, Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, flags auth/PII data sensitivity, and creates a task DAG.
expectations: The skill creates requirements.md with functional and non-functional requirement sections
Acceptance criteria are formulated using Given/When/Then syntax
Data sensitivity for user credentials and PII is explicitly flagged
Open questions are batched into a single list rather than asked piecemeal

evals.prompt: Create a roadmap and PRD for adding stripe payment subscriptions to our SaaS app.
evals.expected_output: The skill generates a PRD flagging payments data sensitivity as CRITICAL risk and breaks work into vertical slices.
expectations: The requirement analysis flags payment processing as CRITICAL data sensitivity
Tasks are deconstructed into a vertical DAG with explicit dependencies
No unrequested scope expansion is introduced beyond subscription payments

evals.prompt: Break down the user stories and acceptance criteria for a real-time chat feature.
evals.expected_output: The skill breaks down user stories into verifiable Given/When/Then acceptance criteria and task DAGs.
expectations: User stories include explicit Given/When/Then acceptance criteria
Non-functional requirements specify latency and WebSocket connection constraints
Definition of done includes automated test verification and clean build exit code
